terms.definition: The loop that runs steps until a run ends.
A new session that starts with a copy of another session up to a chosen entry.
A compaction the agent starts by calling `checkpoint` with a handoff. Its context becomes the session's memory, its notes, the recent entries not yet noted, and the handoff.
Replacing older context with a summary entry; the older entries stay saved.
What the model sees on one model call, built from the entries.
One saved record in a session: a prompt, a reply, a tool result, an instructions update or a summary.
Live progress, such as text as it streams; not saved.
Render the current instruction values into the system prompt at a checkpoint and drop the old updates. Not built.
A message sent during a run that waits for the run to end, then starts a new run.
The text the agent writes when it calls checkpoint; shown again after the checkpoint as a reminder.
Guidance other than the base prompt, such as AGENTS.md, the date, the environment and the attached references; a change is saved as an entry.
A reply or tool call cut short by the user or a crash.
One durable snapshot of what matters in a session, rewritten by dreaming. It belongs to one session, not a project. Saved in the long_term_memory table.
The background job that combines older short-term memory into long-term memory.
Anything the model receives on one call. Roles: system prompt, user, assistant, tool result.
One request to a model; a turn makes more than one when a call is retried.
A reminder in which Tau asks the model to act, such as a context-stage warning or a process exit notice.
One rule a step tries, such as running open tool calls or calling the model.
What the user submits.

A hidden message Tau writes into the context as a user-role message, wrapped in <reminder kind="...">. Kinds: instructions, nudge, checks, run-failed, handoff, short-term-memory, long-term-memory. The chat does not show it.
Everything Tau does for one prompt, until it answers, fails or is stopped.
One saved conversation in one working directory.
Summaries of older ranges of entries, written continuously by a cheap model. Saved in the short_term_memory table.
A message sent during a run; it joins the run after the current turn.
One pass of the agent loop: read the entries, try the operations in order, save what the first one produces.
One model reply and the tool calls it makes.
An instruction change saved after the first message; the model gets it as an instructions reminder.
The context: what the model sees on one call.
